items.title: 为什么衰老的恒星的光度突然下降
items.title_orig: Why Aging Stars Suffer A Sudden Luminosity Dip
items.summary: 当像太阳这样的低质量恒星老化时，它们会离开主序并跟随红巨星分支。当它们上升到这个分支时，它们的亮度稳步增加。但路径中存在一种称为 RGB 亮度凹凸的小问题，它们的亮度会突然下降。
items.summary_orig: When low-mass stars like our Sun age, they leave the main sequence and follow the Red Giant Branch. As they ascend this branch, their luminosity steadily increases. But there's a sort of hiccup in the path called the RGB luminosity bump, where their luminosity suddenly dips.

items.summary: 我维护 Nino，一个用于 C# 的源代码生成的二进制序列化器。我一直致力于的一项优化是反序列化为现有的 .NET SortedList。有线格式交错键和值，而 SortedList 将它们存储在单独的数组中。如果目的地已经有房间，我们可以检查一下吗？
items.summary_orig: I maintain Nino, a source-generated binary serializer for C#. One optimization I’ve been working on is deserializing into an existing .NET SortedList. The wire format interleaves keys and values, while SortedList stores them in separate arrays. If the destination already has room, can we check the order and fill both arrays in one pass?

items.summary_orig: Mars may be more volcanically active than we thought, according to new research. items.title: Canonical 为 Launchpad 添加了 FIDO2硬件密钥支持
items.title_orig: Canonical adds FIDO2 hardware key support to Launchpad
items.summary: 使用 Launchpad 的开发人员现在可以使用 USB FIDO2安全密钥来限制 API 访问，如果没有它，任何被盗的登录信息都将毫无用处。众所周知，Launchpad 是 Canonical 构建 Ubuntu 软件包、托管代码、PPA 以及最终在用户系统上运行的许多其他内容的地方。
items.summary_orig: Developers who use Launchpad can now use a USB FIDO2 security key to restrict API access, which makes any stolen login details useless without it. Launchpad is, as I’m sure you know, where Canonical builds Ubuntu’s package, hosts code, PPAs and many other things that end up on a users’ system.

items.summary: Linux Mint 的下一个版本将提供休眠模式，因此您可以在会话中关闭笔记本电脑，而不必担心电池电量耗尽。今年 12 月发布的 Linux Mint 27 系统管理工具中的新睡眠模式页面可以轻松启用休眠并确保其设置
items.summary_orig: Linux Mint’s next release will offer a hibernation mode, so you can close your laptop mid-session and not worry about returning to a drained battery. A new Sleep Modes page in the System Administration tool in Linux Mint 27, out this December, makes it easy to enable hibernation and ensure it’s setup the way you need.
